newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia to supply DCS 1800 network to China.
newsitem.headline: Nokia to supply DCS 1800 network to China.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia said in a statement on Friday it would deliver this summer a DCS 1800 network to Bejing Telecommunications Administration in China, but did not give the value of the deal.
"The deliveries include mobile switches, base stations, base station controllers and a network management system," Nokia said.
Beijing Telecommunications is already operating a GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) network supplied by Nokia.
Nokia would now supply "an effective dual band GSM/DCS solution where existing mobile switches and base station controllers can flexibly be shared between the two networks," it said.
The new DCS (Digital Cellular System) network would share the existing GSM network's short message service centre (SMSC), which supports Chinese character short message services, Nokia said.
